items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A.T. [Art Taylor] was on it too, and Jackie Mac [McLean] and Dizzy.

ctx.x: I was nervous all the time. Are you kidding me? I was nervous all the time. Somebody asked me – I was on Gil Noble t.v., when they put out that Charlie Parker story. Gil Noble asked me – see, now, here’s a guy. This is a brother, too, and Max is the one that invited me there, because I think he really just wanted Max. A.T. [Art Taylor] was on it too, and Jackie Mac [McLean] and Dizzy. I don’t know if he particularly wanted me, but Max had told me. Anyhow, when we did it in two sections, during the break between…
